name: Fujimura Eriko
source:
A beautiful female doctor working in a big hospital.
Even though being almost 40 years old has a beautiful shining skin, and because of her plump, bouncy body is often the target of mischievous pranks by the patients.
Became a doctor while still young, had spended time in her smooth-sailing life in mutual love with the husband, but was blackmailed and raped by ugly guy Kenji.
